messages:
Ana (marketing): Quick preflight for Wed's announcement. Need: one-line changelog hero, docs anchor, RSVP landing, p95 stat for the blog hero, and inbound lead routing rules. Who can confirm canary window and rollback?
Carlos (eng): Canary Wed 07:30 PT for 3.5h. Ramp plan: 5% -> 30% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if error >2.5% or p95 > SLO for 10m.
Ana (marketing): Thanks. Can we get a 1-line changelog that marketing can paste?
Carlos (eng): "Adaptive KV caching yields ~15% p95 improvement on long-context prompts." Bullets: OOM fix for heavy concurrent batching; new region-aware fallback routing.
Sam (product): Messaging suggestion: "Faster, more reliable inference for long conversations." Short and to the point.
Bea (docs): Docs URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2#changelog. Migration note pinned.
Ana (marketing): Bea, tiny config snippet for the blog? One or two lines.
Bea (docs): Inline snippet: ```
# enable adaptive cache
client.configure({"cache":"adaptive","batching":true})
```
Isha (salesops): Routing: RSVPs -> SFDC campaign "v2_3_launch_q2". High-touch filter: company_size >= 500 -> AE queue "Enterprise-NA"; others -> SDR nurture flow. I'll push mappings and run tests today.
announce-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary roll at 1765011600, full ramp at 1765015200. Monitor: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/176501
Carlos (eng): Heads up: please avoid heavy documentation/API link spikes first 20 minutes to allow cache warmup. We'll post a short runbook (metrics + rollback command) 30m before canary.
Isha (salesops): Test RSVP done, SFDC tag applied, AE queue assignment verified.
Ana (marketing): Plan: landing page live @ 09:00 PT, email waves +30m and +3h, social at +1h. Drafting announcement now, will drop in #marketing-drafts for review in 90m. :rocket:
